title: SSH brute force attack from multiple IPs
symptoms: 500+ failed SSH login attempts in 10 minutes
root_cause: fail2ban service was accidentally stopped during routine maintenance and not restarted
resolution: 1. Restarted fail2ban service. 2. Blocked top 5 attacking IPs at iptables level. 3. Verified fail2ban auto-start on boot. 4. Added monitoring check for fail2ban service status.
diagnosis_commands_run: grep 'Failed password' /var/log/auth.log | awk '{print $(NF-3)}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20
follow_up: Configure fail2ban with aggressive SSH jail settings, add fail2ban status to monitoring dashboard
